businesses.business: Aerospace components and industrial flow equipment

offering_description.value: Crane designs and manufactures braking, sensing and power systems for aircraft manufacturers and defense contractors. It makes valves, pumps, lined piping and instruments for industrial plants and utilities. It also repairs and overhauls aerospace equipment.

primary_products.value: aircraft braking and landing systems; aerospace power and fluid management components; industrial valves and lined piping; pumps; precision sensors and process instruments

primary_services.value: aerospace component repair and overhaul; industrial equipment maintenance and calibration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Aircraft manufacturers, airlines, defense contractors, engineering firms, industrial plant operators and utilities; B2G: Military procurement and maintenance organizations

end_markets.value: commercial aviation; defense and space; chemical processing; energy and power generation; water and wastewater

revenue_model.value: product sales: Aircraft systems and spares, industrial valves, pumps, piping and instruments; service fees: Component repair, overhaul, maintenance and calibration

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: Integrates electronics and machined parts into subsystems for aircraft manufacturers and defense contractors; OEM / manufacturer: Makes valves, pumps, piping and instruments from castings and purchased components for industrial operators; service provider: Repairs and overhauls installed equipment for aircraft fleet and industrial plant operators
value_chain_position.category: component supplier; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: Aerospace systems and electronics, industrial flow equipment, and precision instrumentation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Aircraft manufacturers, defense contractors, engineering firms and major industrial accounts; distributors / dealers: Industrial valve, pump and instrumentation distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FAA and EASA aviation component and repair approvals, defense export controls, and industrial pressure-equipment rules

notes: The current scope of the precision instrumentation portfolio is uncertain.
